text: What distinguishes FORCE learning from standard ESN readout training?
choices: FORCE trains the recurrent weights by backpropagation while the readout stays fixed
FORCE uses offline batch ridge regression with no feedback loop
FORCE freezes the readout and adapts only the input weights
FORCE trains the readout online with RLS while feeding the output back into the reservoir during training
explanation: FORCE trains only the readout, online with RLS, but with an output-to-reservoir feedback loop active throughout training. Standard ESN training is offline ridge with no feedback; FORCE does not use backprop and does not train the recurrent or input weights.
